question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution empowers High Courts to issue writs similar to Article 32?
question_hi: संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद उच्च न्यायालयों को अनुच्छेद 32 के समान रिट जारी करने की शक्ति देता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL 2024 Official Key • NCERT Class 11 Polity

revision_notes.label: High Court Writs
revision_notes.detail: Art. 226 covers both Fundamental Rights and other legal rights (wider than SC's Art. 32).

question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution directs the State to organize Village Panchayats?
question_hi: संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद राज्य को ग्राम पंचायतों का गठन करने का निर्देश देता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 11 Polity

revision_notes.label: Gandhian DPSP
revision_notes.detail: Art. 40 (Part IV) promotes Gram Panchayats; 73rd Amendment (1992) gave constitutional status.

question: Which Schedule of the Indian Constitution contains the Anti-Defection Law?
question_hi: भारतीय संविधान की किस अनुसूची में दल-बदल विरोधी कानून का प्रावधान है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Constitution of India

revision_notes.label: 52nd Amendment (1985)
revision_notes.detail: Added the 10th Schedule; Speaker/Chairman decides disqualification.

question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the idiom: 'Bite the bullet'
question_hi: मुहावरे 'Bite the bullet' का सही अर्थ चुनें

options.text: To face a difficult situation bravely

verified_source: SSC CGL Tier-1 & Tier-2 Official PYQ

revision_notes.label: Memory Hook
revision_notes.detail: Soldiers used to bite a bullet during painful surgery—meaning enduring hardship bravely.

question: One-Word Substitution: A person who knows and can speak many languages.
question_hi: अनेक भाषाएं जानने और बोलने वाला व्यक्ति क्या कहलाता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Blackbook High-Freq

revision_notes.label: Root Word
revision_notes.detail: 'Poly' (many) + 'glot' (tongue/language). Bibliophile = lover of books.

question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the idiom: 'Spill the beans'
question_hi: मुहावरे 'Spill the beans' का सही अर्थ चुनें
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Tier-1 & Tier-2

revision_notes.label: Similar Idiom
revision_notes.detail: 'Let the cat out of the bag' also means revealing a secret unintentionally.

question: Sattriya, one of India's classical dance forms, originated in which Indian state?
question_hi: भारत का शास्त्रीय नृत्य 'सत्त्रिया' किस राज्य से संबंधित है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Sangeet Natak Akademi

revision_notes.label: Founder
revision_notes.detail: 15th-century Vaishnava saint Srimanta Sankardev; recognized as classical in 2000.

question: In which year was the historic Battle of Plassey fought between Siraj-ud-Daulah and the British?
question_hi: सिराजुद्दौला और अंग्रेजों के बीच ऐतिहासिक प्लासी का युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 8 History

revision_notes.label: Key Date
revision_notes.detail: 23 June 1757 (Robert Clive vs Siraj-ud-Daulah). Trap: 1764 = Battle of Buxar.

question: Who founded the 'Brahmo Samaj' in 1828 to reform Hindu society and abolish Sati?
question_hi: 1828 में हिंदू समाज में सुधार और सती प्रथा के अंत के लिए 'ब्रह्म समाज' की स्थापना किसने की?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 8 History

revision_notes.label: Trap Check
revision_notes.detail: Brahmo Samaj (1828) = Raja Ram Mohan Roy | Arya Samaj (1875) = Dayanand Saraswati.

question: Deficiency of which vitamin causes Scurvy, characterized by bleeding gums?
question_hi: किस विटामिन की कमी से स्कर्वी रोग होता है (मसूड़ों से खून आना)?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 6 Science

revision_notes.label: Chemical Name
revision_notes.detail: Vitamin C = Ascorbic Acid (water-soluble). Vit A = Night Blindness, Vit D = Rickets.

question: What is the SI unit of electrical resistance?
question_hi: विद्युत प्रतिरोध (Electrical Resistance) का SI मात्रक क्या है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 10 Science

revision_notes.label: Ohm's Law
revision_notes.detail: V = I × R (Ohm = Ω). Trap: Resistivity's SI unit is Ohm-metre (Ω·m).

question: What is the chemical formula of Baking Soda (Sodium Hydrogen Carbonate)?
question_hi: बेकिंग सोडा (सोडियम बाइकार्बोनेट) का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 10 Chemistry

revision_notes.label: Formula Match
revision_notes.detail: NaHCO3 = Baking Soda | Na2CO3·10H2O = Washing Soda | CaOCl2 = Bleaching Powder.

question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the given word: 'BENEVOLENT'
question_hi: दिए गए शब्द 'BENEVOLENT' का सही समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनें
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Tier-1 & Tier-2

revision_notes.label: Root Word
revision_notes.detail: 'Bene' = good/well (Benevolent = kind & generous). Antonym: Malevolent.

question: Fill in the blank: 'Neither of the two candidates ____ selected for the post.'
question_hi: सही क्रिया (Verb) चुनकर रिक्त स्थान भरें
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Subject-Verb Agreement

revision_notes.label: Golden Rule
revision_notes.detail: 'Neither of / Either of / Each of' + Plural Noun ALWAYS takes a SINGULAR verb (was).

question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word: 'EPHEMERAL'
question_hi: दिए गए शब्द 'EPHEMERAL' का सही विलोम (Antonym) चुनें
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • High-Freq Vocab

revision_notes.label: Meaning
revision_notes.detail: Ephemeral = lasting for a very short time (synonym: Transient). Antonym: Permanent.

question: In MS Excel, which keyboard shortcut is used to insert the current date into a cell?
question_hi: MS Excel में किसी सेल में वर्तमान दिनांक (Current Date) डालने का शॉर्टकट क्या है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Tier-2 Computer PYQ • MS Excel

revision_notes.label: Shortcut Pair
revision_notes.detail: Ctrl + ; inserts Current Date | Ctrl + Shift + ; inserts Current Time.

question: How many layers are there in the OSI (Open Systems Interconnection) networking model?
question_hi: OSI (ओपन सिस्टम्स इंटरकनेक्शन) नेटवर्किंग मॉडल में कुल कितनी परतें (Layers) होती हैं?
verified_source: SSC CGL Tier-2 Computer Official PYQ

revision_notes.label: Mnemonic
revision_notes.detail: Please Do Not Throw Sausage Pizza Away (Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application).

question: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) was established in 1935 on the recommendation of which Commission?
question_hi: भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI) की स्थापना 1935 में किस आयोग की सिफारिश पर हुई थी?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • RBI Official History

revision_notes.label: Key Dates
revision_notes.detail: Established 1 April 1935 (RBI Act 1934); Nationalized on 1 Jan 1949.

question: Kaziranga National Park, famous for the one-horned rhinoceros, is located in which state?
question_hi: एक सींग वाले गैंडे के लिए प्रसिद्ध काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस राज्य में स्थित है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 9 Geography

revision_notes.label: UNESCO Site
revision_notes.detail: Declared UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1985; lies in the Brahmaputra floodplain.

question: Which river is known as 'Dakshin Ganga' (Ganga of the South) in India?
question_hi: भारत में किस नदी को 'दक्षिण गंगा' के नाम से जाना जाता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 9 Geography

revision_notes.label: Peninsular Giant
revision_notes.detail: Rises from Trimbakeshwar (Nashik, MH); longest Peninsular river (~1,465 km).

question: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the Finance Commission constituted?
question_hi: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के तहत वित्त आयोग का गठन किया जाता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Constitution of India

revision_notes.label: Appointed By
revision_notes.detail: President constitutes it every 5 years (1 Chairman + 4 members) for Centre–State tax sharing.
